data.name: Substance_TortArticleInContractClaim
data.value: Civil Code art. 124 is liability for fault outside any contract. This claim arises from a contract: base damages on the contract articles instead (art. 176, or art. 186 for late payment of a sum of money).

data.name: Substance_InterestOnPrivateLoan

data.name: Substance_DamagesWithoutFormalNotice
data.value: Damages are asked but the facts mention no formal notice: under Civil Code art. 179, damages are due only after the debtor has been given formal notice.
